g.text: Deterministic Engineering / DE-CASE-01 · question-led architecture explanation
Who publishes, who selects, and who captures?
Publish reusable contracts. Select the right configuration. Bind real project content.
Design candidate derived from 90.91 / 10.31. Evidence and independent review remain open.
